description.p: You cover the weapon used in the spell's casting with a twisted energy and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, then choose:

Agatho A twisted presence circles around the creature in form of a small cherub and demon. Until the start of your next turn, if the creature willingly moves, the Cherub deals 2d4 radiant damage. If the creature attacks or uses a spell that causes damage, the demon makes the attack or spell cause 2d4 less damage and hurls the absorbed damage against another creature that is allied to the innitial target within 15 feet. The arbsorbed damage becomes necrotic.
Agios A holy energy surrounds the creature. Until the start of your next turn, if the creature attacks or uses a spell that deals damage, the energy bursts inwards dealing 1d8 radiant damage.
Kakos A vile mass of energy circles around the creature, flying towards another creature within a 5-foot radius around the creature. The mass deals 1d8 Necrotic damage to the new target.

This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d4 necrotic damage and 1d4 radiant damage to the target on a hit, and the damage the target takes for causing the spell's respective effects increases by 1 extra die. Both damage rolls increase by 1 die at 11th level (2d4 and 2 extra die) and again at 17th level (3d4 and 3 extra die).

setters.set: A melee weapon worth at least 1 sp

description.p: You cover the weapon used in the spell's casting with a twisted energy and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, then choose:

Agatho Until the start of your next turn, if the creature willingly moves, the spell deals 2d4 radiant damage. If the creature attacks or uses a spell that causes damage, the attack or spell deals 2d4 less damage. The damage is then hurled against a creature within 15 feet of the attacking creature as necrotic damage. The spell ends after one effect occurs.
Agios Until the start of your next turn, if the creature attacks or uses a spell that deals damage, the spell deals 1d8 radiant damage and the spell ends.
Kakos A dark energy flies towards another creature within 5-foot of the attacked creature. The spell deals 1d8 Necrotic damage to the new target.

This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d4 necrotic damage and 1d4 radiant damage to the target on a hit, and the damage the target takes from the spell's respective effects increases by 1 die. Both damage rolls increase by 1 die at 11th level (2d4 and 2 die) and again at 17th level (3d4 and 3 die).

setters.set: A melee weapon worth at least 1 sp

description.p: You gather good and evil Energy into your hands, mixing it and firing it off against a creature within reach. Before you fire off the beam, choose:

Agatho You fire off two beams, choosing their allignements before firing them off. Golden beams heal a creature by 1d8, foul beams deal 1d8 necrotic damage on hit. You make a ranged spell attack for foul beams. You can only heal with this Path during combat.
Agios You fire off one golden beam, healing the creature by 1d10. You can only choose this Path durring Combat.
Kakos You fire off one foul beam, make a ranged spell attack against the creature. On a hit, the spell deals 1d10 Necrotic damage.

The spell creates more beams when you reach higher levels: one additional beam at 5th level, two additional beams at 11th level, and three additional beams at 17th level. You can direct the beams at the same target or different ones. Make a seperate attack roll for each beam if required.
You make a gesture with your hand, mimicking a gun. For the duration, you can use your action, then choose:
Agatho You fire off a Salve of three magic bullets against a creature within 30 feet. Make a ranged spell attack, dealing 1d4 of your choice between Necrotic or Radiant for each bullet on a hit.
Agios You fire off a single bullet against a creature within 240/300 feet. Make a ranged spell attack, dealing 1d8 of your choice between Fire or Radiant damage on a hit.

Kakos You fire off a scattering shot. Each creature of your choice within a 15 feet Cone must make a Constitution Saving Throw, receiving 2d4 of your choice between Cold or Necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels, dealing 1 additional die at 5th level, 2 additional die at 11th level and 3 additional die at 17th level.

You create three glowing darts of twisted energy. Each dart strikes a creature of your choice that you can see within range. The darts strike simultaneously. This spell will be blocked by the "Shield" spell like it would be when casting "Magic Missile. Before you fire off the darts, choose:
Agatho You can choose how many darts hurt or heal. White darts heal a creature for 1d4+1, black dart deal 1d4+1 Necrotic damage. You can choose only one creture for each type of dart.
Agios Each dart turns glowing white, healing a creature for 1d4+1. You can target one or multiple creatures with these darts.
Kakos Each dart turns vile black, dealing 1d4+1 of your choice between Cold or Necrotic damage. You can target only one creature with these darts.
At Higher Levels The spell creates one more dart for each spell slot level above the 1st.
You dash up to 30 feet through a straight line onto an unoccupied space that you can see. Before you dash forth, choose:

Agatho You dash forth with mighty grace. Choose one aspect of Agios and one Aspect of Kakos to use on the allies and other creatures you pass through. The die for healing allies or damaging other creatures are halved.

Agios You dash forth with heavenly grace. If you pass through an allied creature, you heal them for 2d4 + your spellcasting modifier. If you pass through any other creature, they make a Charisma Saving Throw, getting the charmed condition on a failed save until the start of your next turn.

Kakos You dash forth with demonic might. If you pass through an allied creature, they can use their reaction to make one melee attack against a creature within their reach. If you pass through any other creature they take 2d4 + your spellcasting modifier Necrotic damage.
At Higher Levels The spells damage increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above the 2nd.
You create flames, condensing them into a powerfull force before throwing them against your foes at a point within range. Before you send off the flames, choose:

Agatho The point explodes into dense flames that shine golden and black in a 15-foot radius sphere centered on that point and it pulls in any creature and loose object in a 10-foot radius around that sphere. Each creature in the sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 4d6 Necrotic damage and 4d6 Radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A target that got pulled into the explosion takes 3d4 Necrotic damage and 3d4 Radiant damage instead.

Agios The point explodes in golden flames. Each creature in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 4d6 Fire damage and 4d6 Radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The flames spread around corners and lingers for 1 Round. Creatures starting their turn inside the flames or walking into them for the first time recieve 1d4 fire damage and 1d4 radiant damage.

Kakos A 5-foot wide sphere appears at the point that lingers until the start of your 2nd turn after this one. If a creature starts it turn within 30 feet of the sphere, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. A target is pulled 10 feet towards the sphere and looses all but 5 Movement on a failed save. If a creature touches the sphere, the sphere explodes, dealing 4d8 Necrotic damage and 4d8 Cold damage. The sphere then collapses, dealing 2d4 Necrotic damage and 2d4 Cold damage to every other creature within 30 feet.

At Higher Levels. The spells damage increased by 1d4/1d6/1d8 for one type of damage of your choice per Spell Slot Level above the 3rd. (For example, you can either increase the fire damage OR the radiant damage of the Agios effect by 1d6 per spell slot level, but not both)

setters.set: A piece of coal which condenses into a seemingly worthless diamond

description.p: You touch a willing creature, filling it with both holy and unholy prowess to harness for the spells duration. When you touch the creature, choose:

Agatho The target gains resistance against the first type of damage it takes (If it takes multiple damage types at once, choose the one that did the most damage). Additionally, the first time the target hits a creature with a melee attack during this spells duration, it deals an additional 4d8 of your choice between Radiant or Necrotic damage.
Agios The target gains resistance to radiant damage. It also gains temporary Hit Points as high as your spellcasting Modifier + your proficency bonus.
Kakos The target gains resistance to Necrotic damage. Additionally, the first time the target hits a creature with a melee attack in its turn, it deals an additional 2d8 Necrotic damage.
At Higher Levels. You can touch one additional willing creature for every Spell Slot Level above the 4th. You may choose a different Path for each creature.

setters.set: A melee weapon worth at least 1 sp

description.p: You call forth a creature between heaven and hell. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the chosen creatures stat block. The creature shares a telepathic link to you. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends. The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your telepathically (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger. When casting this spell, choose:
Agatho You summon a Battleforce Rot (CR-5)
Agios You summon a Battleforce Angel (CR-5)
Kakos You summon a Rot Angel (CR-5)
At Higher Levels The Challenge Rating (CR) of the summoned creature increases by 1 for each spell slot level above the 5th.

setters.set: An uncut Alexandrite worth at least 500gp, which changes colour based on the light cast upon it

ul.li: Senses Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 90 ft., Truesight 90 ft., Passive Perception 17
Languages Understands all but can't speak it, telepathy 90 ft.

description.p: Astral Implosion. The rot doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
Magic Resistance. The rot has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Multiattack. The rot makes one Decaying Longsword attack and uses Battlefield Inspiration.
Pseudopod. Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage, or of the target is a corpse or undead, the necrotic damage increases to 36 (8d8).

Additionally, for the next 24 hours, the target is marked for death. A creature who drops to 0 hit points while marked for death immediately fails one death saving throw. This effect isn't cumulative. .
Battlefield Inspiration. The rot chooses up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Until the end of the angel's next turn, each target can add a d4 to its attack rolls and saving throws.

Hypnotic Beam. One of the angel's eyes shoots a magic ray at a creature the angel can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move as far as their speed allows toward the angel, aboiding obviously dangerous ground.

Radiant Puff When the angel is hit with an attack, they release a cloud of spores. Each creatuer within 10 feet of the angel must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throe or be blinded until the end of the rot angel's next turn.

ul.li: Senses Darkvision 120 ft., Truesight 120 ft., Passive Perception 16

description.p: Flyby. The angel doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
Magic Resistance. The angel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Multiattack. The angel makes two melee attacks. It also uses Battlefield Inspiration.

Longsword. Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage. If the target is within 5 feet of any of the angel's allies, the target takes an extra 2 (1d4) Radiant damage.

Battlefield Inspiration. The angel chooses up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Until the end of the angel's next turn, each target can add a d4 to its attack rolls and saving throws.
